diagram_math_checks.result: Top-to-bottom wires q2,q1,q0 are precisely the ordered three-qubit tensor register in the exact algorithm input. Each H acts on one C^2 factor; each CP_s acts on the indicated two factors as diag(1,1,1,exp(2 pi i/2^s)) from def-qa-qft-gate-cost-model, extended by identity to the register. All executed gates are endomorphisms of the same three-qubit register.

alg-qa-exact-binary-qft-circuit Definition step 1 first applies H(q2), then i=0 gives CP3(q0 control,q2 target), then i=1 gives CP2(q1 control,q2 target). The figure places these at x=1,2,3. Since m=2, CP3 is dashed and explicitly omitted; CP2 is solid, with its filled control dot on q1.

The j=1 block is H(q1) at x=4 followed by CP2(q0 control,q1 target) at x=5; the j=0 block contains only H(q0) at x=6. Thus exactly three H and two CP2 gates execute, in the inherited loop order. Dashed ghost control is an open marker, distinct from executed filled controls.

Definition step 2 has j=0 only when n=3, swapping q0 with q2 after all blocks. The solid linked crosses at x=7 depict exactly this SWAP. Its vertical line crosses q1 without a dot or box, so q1 is unchanged by that gate. There are no other asserted swaps, arrows, or commutativity relations.

Original algorithmic Definition is unchanged. The figure is only the n=3,m=2 instance of its deletion rule; its dashed position is explicitly not an executed operation. The general finite-list and unitarity claims do not rely on the picture.
